name: Iogi Takeshi
source:
Takeshi is a male friend of [url=/c1633]Kouhei[/url]'s. He generally ignores what happens in class, being a very lazy and unproductive person, but still knows the situation with [url=/c1630]Aeka[/url]. He is less sympathetic towards her than [url=/c63388]Misaki[/url] is. Often converses with [url=/c63388]Misaki[/url].

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yume_Miru_Kusuri:_A_Drug_That_Makes_You_Dream]Wikipedia[/url]]
